statement: Let f be a normalized primitive weight-two newform of trivial nebentypus and level Nf , and let A be its modular abelian factor. Let K have odd fundamental discriminant −D < −4, prime to Nf , and suppose every prime dividing Nf splits in K. Thus O× K = {±1}, and the split height formula (GZ) applies. Let Ff be a finite extension of Q2 containing the image of a fixed Hecke coefficient embedding, and let Vf be the corresponding two-dimensional Tate representation over Ff , allowing a further finite scalar extension when needed. Assume Vf |GK absolutely irreducible. Then L(f/K, s) has a simple zero at 1 =⇒ H1 f (K, Vf ) = Ff y, y ̸= 0, τy = −w(f)y, (K0) where y is the Kummer class of the projected Hilbert trace. The Selmer notation on the right means ordinary Kummer finite conditions, with conjugate rational twist components over Q recovered by quadratic isogeny. In particular the summand whose L-function has nonzero central value has zero such Selmer and the simple-zero summand rank one, since w(f) is the functional sign over Q and the split product sign is minus. Dual Tate via a polarization gives the same assertions rationally. The conclusion concerns the characteristic-zero Selmer rank at the indicated coefficient. For a general A, no assertion of finiteness for its entire prime-primary Tate–Shafarevich group is included.
